cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the XE P300 from 2023 to present. The AJ200P features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ200P V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ200P rebuild.
